description: Renovate handles all dependency updates (replacing the bulk 'Sec :: Dep updater'): one update per package, each behind a checkbox on the Dependency Dashboard, so a broken release blocks only its own item (see intel/enterprise-rag#191).

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Turn the repository's Dependabot alerts into fixes, including transitive deps that only exist in a lock file (e.g. dnspython via pymongo: uv lock --upgrade-package dnspython==<fixed>). Fixes use the lowest patched version and, like every other update, wait for approval on the dashboard (Renovate's default would open them immediately). Needs Dependabot alerts enabled and 'Dependabot alerts: read' on RENOVATE_TOKEN.

packageRules.description: Python (pyproject.toml + uv.lock) and JS (pnpm workspace): in-range updates only touch the lock file (uv lock --upgrade-package / pnpm), out-of-range ones also move the range ('>=1.77.0,<2' -> '>=3.51,<4', tight caps such as torchvision<0.29.0 -> <0.30.0). Write major caps as '<N', not '<N.0.0': Renovate keeps the precision of the cap, so '<2.0.0' would become '<3.52.0'.
Go: tidy go.sum and rewrite import paths on /vN major bumps. One item per module, except modules that must move together (otel, k8s; grouped by config:recommended).
Helm: track all versions of external charts.

customManagers.description: SeaweedFS Helm chart installed by Ansible (roles/app_edp/tasks/seaweedfs.yaml) with the version pinned in the EDP values file.
